headline: Ribeiro's high involvement and Riverside's early-second-half attacking surge produced the 49' goal
explanation: The goal at 49' followed a sustained period of attacking activity from Riverside Athletic immediately after half-time: the team registered 30 events including four shots and 0.54 xG in minutes 46–49. Ribeiro was central to that sequence, combining four dribbles, 16 passes and three shots before the 49th minute, which shows he was both progressing the ball and taking shooting responsibility — actions that directly contributed to the scoring opportunity.
tactical_pattern: Central ball progression by the key attacking midfielder (Ribeiro) linking dribbles and quick passing during an early second-half attack surge
